evals.name: GitHub Actions SSH Deployment Workflow Scaffolding
evals.prompt: Scaffold a GitHub Actions deployment workflow using appleboy/ssh-action to deploy Docker Compose services to a remote VPS.
evals.expected_output: Creates deploy.yml referencing official SSH action, binding mandatory repository secrets, and pulling latest branch commits.
assertions: Configures workflow triggered on push to main or master branch
Uses official appleboy/ssh-action@v1 action for SSH connectivity
Interpolates secrets for SERVER_HOST, USERNAME, SSH_KEY, PORT, and PROJECT_PATH
Executes git pull to synchronize deployment scripts and configurations

evals.name: Zero-VPS Compilation Enforcement & Image Pulling
evals.prompt: Configure remote VPS deployment commands to pull pre-built container registry images rather than compiling code on the server.
evals.expected_output: Executes docker compose with --pull always and existing-infra / repo layers without triggering server-side builds.
assertions: Uses docker compose up -d with --pull always flag
Avoids executing docker compose --build on the target VPS server
Attaches application container to existing shared database networks

evals.name: Secrets Checklist & Post-Deploy Pruning
evals.prompt: Provide instructions for adding repository secrets and ensure the deployment workflow cleans up dangling image layers.
evals.expected_output: Generates a structured checklist of required secrets and appends docker image prune -f to the deployment script.
assertions: Documents required secrets (SERVER_HOST, SERVER_USERNAME, SERVER_SSH_KEY, SERVER_PORT, PROJECT_PATH)
Appends docker image prune -f cleanup command to script block
Instructs user on generating dedicated deployment SSH key pairs
